title: Kulamalu Park stairs fall lawsuit settlement
summary: On September 29, 2026, the Council adopted Resolution 26-147, authorizing a settlement of a lawsuit against the County. Earlier that day, a vote was called on a motion to discharge the Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee from the resolution so the Council could act immediately, though the recording does not capture the result.
